attr.title: Bolzplatz 2006 (Slam Soccer 2006)
attr.desc: Bolzplatz 2006, released in English as Slam Soccer 2006, is a funny football game in 3D comic style by Xenoage Software. Play friendly matches, a world cup or a full career with your own team, featuring wacky stadiums, weather and commentators. Includes the Gold Edition data.
attr.inst: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed. The first launch extracts the game data, which takes a few minutes.
